//: Build settings live here rather than in the Vercel dashboard so importing
the repo needs no configuration, and so the settings are reviewable.
The build must run from the REPOSITORY ROOT, not from site/. The generators
in internal/ read dictionary/ and internal/Curriculum.md and write both
README.md and site/src/data/. Point the root directory at site/ and they
never run: the app then builds from whatever data was last committed, so a
content change deploys stale and the build still goes green.
framework is null on purpose. next.config.ts uses output: 'export', so the
artifact is plain static files in site/out. Declaring nextjs here would make
Vercel look for a .next build at the root and fail.
